responsibilities: You'll lead the design and development of production-grade ELT pipelines using dbt and BigQuery, own the modelling of complex and business-critical datasets across areas such as payments, credit and growth, and drive best practices in data modelling, testing, CI/CD and performance optimisation.

Working closely with Data Engineering, BI Engineering and business stakeholders, you'll help ensure data is accessible, reliable and cost-efficient, while mentoring other analytics engineers and shaping the standards that support a high-performing data function.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: drive best practices in data modelling, testing, CI/CD and performance optimisation... implementing data quality controls, monitoring and automated testing
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: The JD repeatedly emphasizes testing, engineering standards, data quality controls and monitoring with no velocity/speed language, clearly rigour.
evidence.domain_risk: own the modelling of complex and business-critical datasets across areas such as payments, credit and growth... Experience within Fintech, Financial Services, Payments or Retail Banking
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The role sits at Curve, a fintech within Lloyds Banking Group, working directly on payments and credit datasets, an explicit financial-services override to high domain risk.
evidence.data_team_maturity: join Curve's central data team, helping to build a robust and scalable analytics platform
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A central data team with distinct Data Engineering and BI Engineering functions already collaborating, but the platform itself is still being built into a 'robust and scalable' state, indicating a growing mid-stage function.
evidence.jd_authorship: You'll lead the design and development of production-grade ELT pipelines using dbt and BigQuery... Strong experience with BigQuery, including incremental models, partitioning and cost optimisation
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities and requirements name specific tools (dbt, BigQuery, Airflow, Terraform) and precise technical concepts (incremental models, partitioning) giving a clear picture of daily work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: own the modelling of complex and business-critical datasets across areas such as payments, credit and growth... Working closely with Data Engineering, BI Engineering and business stakeholders
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role serves both internal data/engineering functions and business-critical commercial domains (payments, credit, growth) with genuinely equal weight, so mixed.
evidence.autonomy_level: You'll lead the design and development of production-grade ELT pipelines... drive best practices... while mentoring other analytics engineers and shaping the standards
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role combines leading pipeline design and shaping team standards (strategic) with hands-on modelling and delivery work (execution), a genuine mix.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No AI tool usage or AI-infrastructure-building expectation appears anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing: drive best practices in data modelling, testing, CI/CD and performance optimisation... Experience implementing data quality controls, monitoring and automated testing
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing strategies and quality controls are explicitly framed as something the candidate establishes and drives, an ownership framing rather than a listed tool.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: you'll help ensure data is accessible, reliable and cost-efficient
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: There is a clear reliability and cost-efficiency concern for business-critical payments/credit data, but it is secondary to the platform-building/delivery framing rather than a dominant compliance register, so moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: helping to build a robust and scalable analytics platform that transforms raw data into trusted, analytics-ready data products... own the modelling of complex and business-critical datasets
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role both builds a more robust/scalable version of the analytics platform (greenfield direction) and owns/maintains existing business-critical datasets (fix/scale), a genuine mix.
evidence.work_arrangement: Our work style is hybrid, which involves spending at least two days per week, or 40% of our time, at one of our office sites.
evidence.loss_aversion: you'll help ensure data is accessible, reliable and cost-efficient — a moderate reliability/trust concern rather than an explicit dominant compliance/regulatory risk register despite the fintech/banking context.
